name: aristotl
description: Search your company's procedures and training, check assignments and analytics, and create courses and checklists in Aristotl.

interface.longDescription:
Aristotl is a training platform for frontline teams. Connect it to ChatGPT to use your organisation's procedures, training and analytics in chat, with exactly the permissions you have in Aristotl.

What you can do:
- Search your company's knowledge base and get answers with links back to the source document.
- See your assigned courses, checklists and certifications, with due dates.
- Read a course outline and check the calendar.
- As an author or admin, create and edit courses, checklists, certifications and calendar events. ChatGPT asks you to confirm each change, and it appears in Aristotl straight away.
- As an admin, draft course outlines, start lesson generation in Aristotl (it uses your organisation's AI allowance) and ask for training analytics such as completions by store.

Each connection is tied to one organisation you choose when you connect. Your organisation's admin can turn the connector off or disconnect any connection, and you can disconnect your own under Profile, Connected apps.

Aristotl receives only the requests ChatGPT sends to it, never your chat history. You need an Aristotl account from your organisation.
defaultPrompt: Search Aristotl for how we handle allergen questions at the counter.
Which training is assigned to me and when is it due?
Show me the outline of the Food Safety Basics course.

positive.prompt: Search Aristotl for how we handle allergen questions at the counter.
positive.expected_behavior: A search results widget citing the "Allergen Policy" source and related lessons, with links into Aristotl.

positive.prompt: Which training is assigned to me and when is it due?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the assigned courses, checklist and certification with their due dates.

positive.prompt: Show me the outline of the Food Safety Basics course.
positive.expected_behavior: An outline widget with 3 modules and 7 lessons, and a link to the course.

positive.prompt: How many people completed Food Safety Basics, by store?
positive.expected_behavior: An analytics widget with a row for Antwerp Store and one for Ghent Store; small groups are shown as too few people to show.

positive.prompt: Create a checklist in Aristotl for closing the store at night with five tasks.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT asks to confirm the write; a draft checklist with five tasks appears in Aristotl, with a link.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Antwerp tomorrow?
Search the web for this week's EU food-safety news.
Generate a photo of a smiling barista for my slides.
